newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TALLINNA SAYS NEW SHARES AIMED AT FOREIGNERS.
newsitem.headline: TALLINNA SAYS NEW SHARES AIMED AT FOREIGNERS.

text.p: A new share issue by Tallinna Pank is aimed mainly at foreign investors and the bank is still deciding whether to issue them as ordinary shares or as global depository receipts (GDRs), chairman Rait Lukas said Thursday.
He was clarifying earlier remarks to Reuters in a recent interview about the new share issue.
"The new shares are aimed principally at foreigners," Lukas told Reuters.
The share issue is of one million shares at a nominal value of one kroon each. The price of the issue has not yet been decided.
Lukas said that Tallinna Pank was currently seeking for a bank or investment house to arrange the share issue.
